_comment: Two engraving slips in m64 of the string-quartet source (The_Art_of_Fugue_Contrapunctus_1_String_Quartet_.musicxml): the raised leading tone / third of the A-major dominant was written Db instead of C#. Both sit over an A-dominant harmony where C# is a consonant major third and Db is a diminished-fourth wolf (rule (a), vertical, asymmetric sonority). b1.25 (Vln1): sounds A2 A4 C#5, arpeggiating A7 (line G5->C#5->F5, 7th->3rd) resolving to i6; b2.75 (Vla): sounds A2 C#3 G4 E5 = a clean A7 (V7) resolving to III/i. Every other midi-73 in mm.63-65 is already C# (m63 b1.0 Vln1, m63 b2.75 Vln2, m65 b1.25 Vln1) — these two are the outliers. Not circular: decided by struck chord + resolution + local key (D minor), speller only surfaced the candidate.

rules.via: vertical/leading-tone (third of dominant A7, V of d)
